title: Returning from a restoring state
statement: Let $y$ be a Boolean word, let $eq$ be an optional Boolean value, and let $i,k,p,q$ be natural numbers. If $i\le |y|+1$, $k\le |y|+1$, and $q\le |\mathrm{bits}(k)|$, then there is a finite safe computation path from the restoring configuration with value $eq$, parameters $i,k,p$, and tape-$2$ head position $q-1$ to the configuration determined by the exit rule for $eq$, with parameters $0,k,p$.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers i, k, p, q
